passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Trimezia gracilis (Herb.) Christenh. & Byng.
The native range of this species is W. Central & SE. Brazil to Paraguay. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
